title: Marvell Stock: Buy or Sell? | MRVL Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA flips Marvell from AVOID, set on 11 October 2026, to BUY, after revising his discounted cash flow model higher. He gives a fair value of $248 against a stated market price of about $249, so the stock is fairly valued on his revised model, with a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 34, near the expensive end for 2026. In the video he frames the move as an upgrade from hold following his downgrade after the early-year surge past $300; the watch's last tracked explicit direction was AVOID against a $200 fair value then, so it is recorded as an AVOID to BUY flip. His thesis is that management's target of $80 billion of revenue by fiscal 2031 at a 45% operating margin is fantastic and reasonable against a $400 billion total addressable market by 2030, with AI demand and a booming backlog meaning Marvell wins regardless of whose chips go into data centres. His bull case cites analyst forecasts of 56% earnings-per-share growth over the next few years and revenue per employee rising from about $400,000 in 2017 to $1.16 million trailing. His bear case is that cash flow from operations to sales has been stuck at 23% since 2018, not improving versus other AI semiconductor names.
